assumptions: Printed geometry treated as solid PLA, not a slicer mass
Inherited metal geometry treated as steel; new hubs/journals as aluminum, radial screws as brass; materials unqualified
Unmodeled hand/wrist provision is a 100g point at wrist, not a measured part
